svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three holes with sloping walls go down through a thin flat oxide and a dotted glass, two to the silicon and a shallower one in the middle to the top of the wide stack, with resist still on the surface. After it the resist is gone and the holes are unchanged.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. svg.text: Before: the holes under the contact resist (step 094)
The last clean before metal: on this reference's reading,
the resist is stripped and the holes are cleaned.
After: the resist stripped, the holes open and clean
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
